items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I put the group, and I had Pop Foster on bass and Andy Anderson on guitar

ctx.x: The old man played saxophone. Uh-huh, he played saxophone and clarinet. And when he was a delegate, he took a great liking to me because he was a member of this lodge before I got in there. It was all the old timers. So this time -- entertainers, musicians, all the greatest belonged to that lodge. That's why they call it the Musician's Lodge, because so many of the guys belonged to it before I got there.
And when he opened up the Playhouse, when he called me to put the group in there, and being close with him, I put the group, and I had Pop Foster on bass and Andy Anderson on guitar --
